page.layout: Running head at top, page number at top right. Below it, two circular portrait medallions side by side, each with a legend around its rim (left: Pharamond, right: Clodio). Below them one column of running text, two paragraphs. No margin notes, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.l: I. F. REX I.
PHARAMOND
F. REX 2.
CLODIO
FARAMVNDVS, primus Francorum Rex incepit a-
pud eos imperare anno mundi 4383. à Christo nato 421. fuit
hic Marcomiri Francorū Ducis filius, sed ut paulò altius rem
repetam, Franci Troia oriundi (qua capta, Duce primùm Fran-
cione, ad Mœotim paludē se contulerant, nec procul ab ea ur-
bem condiderant, quā ad Valentinianum usque Valentiani fi-
lium ac Gratiani fratrem incoluerant) Duce Marcomiro, Fara-
mundi patre, in eam Germaniæ regionem, quæ nunc Franco-
nia dicitur, concesserant tum cum ad vectigal pensitandum re-
uocati, Imperium, circa paludem Mœotidē agentes, detrectas-
sent. Sub Faramûdo primùm usi sunt legibus Fràci:tunc enim
quatuor ex primoribus qui cōtrouersias dirimeret, elegerunt:
tunc etiam lex Saliqua cōdita Regnat. Faramundus apud Fran-
cos annos 11. Robertus Gaguin. li.1. Paul. item Æmyl. li.1.
CLODIO, secundus Francorum Rex Faramundo patri
succedit, anno mundi 4394. à Christo nato 432. Hic Thurin-
gos subegit: Cameracum cepit: Romanos ad Rhenum proftra-
uit: traiecto flumine, Tornacum etiam cepit, in Galliam traie-
cit, finitimos Reges vicit: Burgundiam, Tholosam, totámque
Aquitaniam in potestatem redegit: comatos voluit esse Fran-
cos, libertatis indicium, comatus ipse dictus. Rexit annos 18.
Vide ut supra.

page.notes: Two circular woodcut medallions of coin-type portraits, each with a legend around the rim; the legends are transcribed above as lines (left: "I. F. REX I." and "PHARAMOND"; right: "F. REX 2." and "CLODIO"). The exact numerals on the left medallion are hard to read at this scan resolution. The page has no marginal notes. The line "Vide ut supra" sits at the end of the second paragraph. The "4 3 8 3" and similar date digits are printed with wide spacing, transcribed without spaces.
